content: Let the dog bark at the elephant as it walks gracefully down the street; let the world talk while the wise remain undisturbed.
author: Kabir
explanation: The elephant does not halt its majestic stride to argue with barking dogs. Stay focused on your noble mission and let the petty noise of gossip and criticism fade behind you.
practicalInsight: Ignore idle chatter, social media rumors, and petty slights today. Walk with serene purpose toward your higher duty.
reflectionPrompt: How much valuable time and emotional energy am I wasting reacting to barking dogs?
